about: ETHERION 전장 그림 작업 목록 (스타일 가이드 2.11 · 2.17 · 3.1 · 6.6 · 6.7). build_prompts.js가 읽어 prompts/ui.jsonl · ui.md를 만든다. refs = 그림 AI에 함께 넣는 참고 그림(자리 · 모양을 맞춤, tools/art/ref = v3.9.14 그림을 얼려 둔 것), 'out:<id>' = 이번에 먼저 만든 같은 묶음의 그림. post.alpha: 'ref:<파일>' = 그 파일의 투명 모양을 그대로 씌움(코드가 얹는 자리와 어긋나지 않게), 'luma' = 검은 바탕을 투명으로. 그림 안에 글자 · 숫자를 넣지 않는다 — 숫자 · 장수 · 차오름은 코드가 얹는다(가이드 0.2).
style: Style: dark fantasy game art, painterly digital painting with rich texture, dramatic lighting; theme 'night sky and golden runes'.
Palette: night #07080d / #0d1019, gold #d9b46a / #f6e2a8 / #8a6a2a, ether sky-blue #8fdcff, faction colours brass #d4893a, verdant #6fae55, arcane #a57ae6.

Seven dragon element gems (when a ring of gems appears) in this order clockwise from north: earth #b88a5a (N), wind #9fe3d6 (NE), [east seat EMPTY], fire #ff6b3d (SE), water #4fb3ff (S), forest #58b85f (SW), metal #a9b4c2 (W), lightning #ffd84a (NW). The empty east seat is a dark empty socket.
avoid: No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no UI frame, no buttons.
Keep exactly the same position, size, outline and layout as the reference image; repaint only the surface (materials, light, texture).

assets.title: 전장 배경
assets.note: 전장 화면 전체에 깔린다(불투명도 .9, 위치 center 60%). 가운데는 카드가 올라가므로 어둡고 고요하게. 숫자 · 카드 자리는 코드.
prompt: Wide 16:9 background painting for the battle screen of a dark-fantasy card game, seen from a low elevated view at night.

Horizon at about 40% height. Left: a dark mountain range that is secretly the body of a sleeping stone giant, with a slanted row of small orange mine-lamp lights climbing its slope. Right: distant silhouette of white-stone arcane spires (three tall needle towers) with faint violet lights at their tips. Sky: deep violet-indigo night with thin clouds and stars; very faint in the sky above the centre, a huge ghostly circle with a five-pointed star (the halo of the gods), barely visible.

Foreground ground plane: a vast dark stone plaza or dark still water, and lying on it in perspective a huge ancient engraved ring (the Ring of Seven Dragons) with seven softly glowing gem seats around it (see palette order), the east seat empty and dark with a broken section of the ring.
The centre 60% of the image must stay dark, calm and low-contrast — playing cards are placed on top of it. No bright spots in the middle. Overall quite dark, cinematic.

assets.title: 카드 뒷면 · 덱 맨 위
assets.note: 글씨 없는 원본(card_back_plain.png). 만든 뒤 python tools/art/cardback_text.py 로 ETHERION 글씨를 얹어 card_back.png를 굽는다(v3.19.2). 덱 맨 위 · 상대 핸드 · 뽑혀 날아오는 카드가 함께 쓴다(5:7). 덱 옆면(금박)과 장수는 코드. 모서리는 CSS가 둥글게 자른다.
prompt: The back side of a playing card, portrait 5:7, filling the whole image edge to edge (no background around the card).

Thin black outer edge, then a hammered gold border, inside a deep indigo-violet nebula field with a faint diamond lattice and tiny stars, ornate gold corner brackets with small sky-blue gems in the four corners, small gold diamonds at top and bottom centre.

Centre: the ETHERION sigil — an outer ring of seven carved wedge-shaped bronze/adamant stones (the seven giants), inside a gold ring with seven round element gems in the palette order and an EMPTY dark socket in the east (right) with a dotted broken ring segment, a five-pointed star drawn in violet light lines (#a57ae6) inside a thin circle, and at the very centre an EMPTY black circle with a gold rim (Arche — nothing inside it).
Symmetrical, precise, ornamental, readable at small size (96 px wide).

assets.title: 소각장(성화대) — 뒤 층
assets.note: 세 층(뒤 → 타는 카드 → 불꽃 → 앞 테두리) 중 맨 뒤. 그릇 · 안쪽 잔불 · 손잡이 · 받침. 투명 모양은 지금 그림 그대로 씌운다.
prompt: Isolated object on a transparent background: a wide hammered-bronze ritual brazier bowl seen slightly from above, the inside of the bowl glowing with red-orange embers and charred black fragments, a thin gold rim, two round ring handles left and right, a band of small glowing rune marks and seven tiny element gems around the bowl's outer side (east seat empty).
Below: a short dark stone stem and a three-step dark violet-black stone base; the bottom step has seven small carved rectangular niches outlined in gold (the seven giants).
The bowl and base occupy the lower part of the image exactly as in the reference; everything above the bowl is empty/transparent. NO flames in this layer (flames are a separate layer).

assets.title: 소각장(성화대) — 불꽃 층
assets.note: 화면 합성(screen)으로 얹는 불꽃. 검은 바탕으로 그리면 검정이 투명이 된다. 불꽃 밑동은 그림 높이 약 69~76%(그릇 안). 불이 없을 때는 코드가 낮게 줄여 잔불로 쓴다.
prompt: Only flames on a pure black background (#000000), nothing else: a tall magical fire rising from the inside of a bowl (the base of the flames is a flat line at about 72-76% of the image height, width about 70% of the image).
Colour: white-hot gold-orange at the base, turning into ether sky-blue (#8fdcff) at the tips, with a few orange and sky-blue sparks drifting upward. Painterly, soft glowing edges.
Same position and size as the reference flame. No bowl, no ground, no smoke clouds.

assets.title: 소각장(성화대) — 앞 테두리 층
assets.note: 타는 카드 · 불꽃 앞에 오는 그릇의 앞 테두리(금 고리)만.
prompt: Isolated on transparent background: only the thin elliptical gold rim of the brazier bowl (front lip), polished hammered gold with tiny diamond studs, exactly matching the bowl of the reference in size and position. Nothing else.

assets.title: 에테르 제단 — 뒤 층 (삼위일체: 신 · 거인 · 용)
assets.note: 에테르 원형 장치의 그림(v3.19.6). 세계관 1장의 세 갈래 — 위 신(뜻) · 왼쪽 아래 거인(몸) · 오른쪽 아래 용(힘)이 정삼각형 구도로 둘러싼다. 지킬 것: ① 가운데 지름 46%(330px) 원은 완전히 비운다 — 코드가 지름 43.1%(310px) 하늘빛 구슬과 숫자를 그 위에 그린다. 구슬을 그리지 않는다. ② 지름 46~62% 고리는 얇은 룬 결계선만 — 결정 9칸 · 정수가 지름 56% 둘레(12시부터 36도씩)에 놓인다. ③ 세 존재는 지름 62% 바깥. ④ 원판과 세 존재가 그림 틀 안에 다 들어온다(v3.19.7 그림은 원판이 틀보다 커서 잘렸다). 그림 가운데 = 구슬 가운데. 구멍 비율이 달라도 게임에 넣을 때 js/game.js ETHER_ART.size로 맞춘다(104 × 그림 px ÷ 구멍 px). 결정이 그림과 겹치면 js/game.js ETHER_SLOTS에서 옮긴다.
avoid: No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no UI frame, no buttons.

Do not paint a central orb, gem, sphere, portal or glowing core — the centre must stay empty dark background; the game draws its own ether orb there. Do not paint crystals arranged as slots or counters.
No hands, wings, tails, breath, robes or any part of the three beings may enter the central 62% circle.
Nothing may be cut off by the edges of the image: the whole round disc, the halo, the wings and the three beings stay fully inside the square with a small dark margin.
prompt: Square composition on a plain flat very dark background (#07080d), seen from the front: an ornate circular ether altar emblem for a dark-fantasy card game, framing a large EMPTY round centre.
The empty centre is a perfect circle 46% of the image width, exactly in the middle of the square: plain flat dark background only, nothing painted inside it.
Directly around that hole, a thin calm ring of gold-and-stone with faint glowing ancient runes, reaching out to about 62% of the image width; keep this ring low in detail.

Outside that ring, three beings of the ether frame the circle in an equilateral triangle, each facing the centre but staying outside the 62% ring: at the top, a radiant winged god with a five-pointed star halo (will, arcane violet light); at the bottom left, a massive mountain-stone giant veined with glowing adamant magma (body, brass and ember orange); at the bottom right, a roaring jade-green horned dragon with spread wings (power, verdant light).
The three beings may reach into the corners of the square but stay fully inside it; the whole emblem fills the square to about 95% and must read clearly at small size (about 120 px on screen).

assets.title: 에테르 제단 — 앞 층 (선택)
assets.note: 선택. 구슬 앞에 겹칠 부분만(구슬을 감싸는 발톱 · 몸 토막 · 앞 테두리 등). 없으면 만들지 않아도 된다 — 뒤 층만으로도 게임에 들어간다.
avoid: No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no UI frame, no buttons.
Match the reference exactly in position and size; paint only the parts that overlap the front of the central orb, leave everything else transparent.
prompt: Isolated on transparent background, matching the altar of the reference: only the elements that pass in front of the central orb (for example claws gripping it or a segment of the coil crossing its lower edge). Same materials and light as the reference. Everything else transparent.

assets.title: 생명(심장석) — 빈 보석
assets.note: 생명이 빠진 부분에 보이는 어두운 빈 보석. 세 장(빈 보석 · 핏빛 · 금 테)이 정확히 겹친다.
prompt: Isolated on transparent background: a large faceted gem shaped like an elongated hexagonal shield (pointed top, pointed bottom), dark smoky garnet glass, almost empty and drained, with subtle facet lines and one soft white highlight at upper left. Exactly the same outline and facets as the reference.

assets.title: 생명(심장석) — 핏빛 보석
assets.note: 생명만큼 아래에서 차오르는 층(코드가 위를 잘라 냄). 위아래 어디를 잘라도 어색하지 않게 고르게.
prompt: Isolated on transparent background: the same faceted gem as the reference, but full of glowing living blood-red light (#e0344a to deep crimson), bright core in the centre, luminous facets, faint inner swirl like a beating heart. Light evenly distributed from top to bottom (the game crops it from the top). Exactly the same outline and facets.

assets.title: 생명(심장석) — 금 테
assets.note: 보석 위에 얹는 금 테와 네 발톱 장식. 가운데는 비워 둔다(보석이 보여야 함). 금 간 자국은 코드.
prompt: Isolated on transparent background: only an ornate gold bezel frame tracing the outline of the gem, with four leaf-shaped gold prongs at top, bottom, left and right, each with a small red jewel. The inside of the frame is completely empty/transparent. Exactly the same shape as the reference.

assets.title: 상단 문장 로고 (ETHERION)
assets.note: 상단 띠 가운데 ETHERION 문장 자리. 글자 뒤에 거인(산맥/청동 불빛) · 용(거대한 날개와 목) · 신(오각별 후광과 신성한 빛)의 웅장한 어두운 실루엣이 배치된다. 그림이 있으면 그 그림을 쓰고, 없으면 코드로 된 글자를 쓴다.
prompt: Ornate fantasy game title logo for 'ETHERION' in a wide horizontal banner format (5:1 aspect ratio), on a pure black or transparent background.

Center: the word 'ETHERION' rendered in carved metallic gold and hammered bronze typography with sharp classical serif edges, intricate glowing golden rune engravings, and soft cyan/violet ether highlights along the bevels.
Behind the lettering, dramatic dark mythical silhouettes of the three world forces:
(1) Left: a colossal stone Giant silhouette rising like a mountain ridge with faint glowing orange mine-lamps and molten bronze seams;
(2) Center-top: a majestic celestial Dragon silhouette spreading massive dark wings over the title, with subtle glowing ether sky-blue (#8fdcff) along its horns, scales, and eyes;
(3) Right: an ethereal divine God silhouette draped in cosmic starlight with a faint glowing five-pointed star halo (#a57ae6) and thin sacred light rays beaming downward.
The overall silhouettes are dark and atmospheric so the gold 'ETHERION' letters remain instantly legible and prominent.
Style: dark fantasy game art, painterly digital painting with rich texture, dramatic lighting; theme 'night sky and golden runes'.
Palette: night #07080d, gold #d9b46a / #f6e2a8 / #8a6a2a, ether sky-blue #8fdcff, brass orange #d4893a, arcane violet #a57ae6.
No UI buttons, no border frame, no other text besides 'ETHERION'.

assets.title: 전장 배경 2 (3파전 — 거인 · 용 · 신의 격돌)
assets.note: 전장 두 번째 배경: 잠에서 깨어난 대지의 거인, 하늘을 뒤덮은 원소의 용, 천상에서 강림하는 비술의 신이 격돌하는 3파전 전장. 가운데 60%는 카드 가독성을 위해 어둡고 차분하게 유지.
prompt: Wide 16:9 cinematic dark-fantasy battle background painting showing the epic three-way clash of the Giant, the Dragon, and the God at night.
Horizon at about 40% height.

Left: a colossal stone and adamantine Giant awakening from the mountains, towering against the stormy sky, steam and glowing orange molten fire bursting from its chest and cracked skin, brandishing a massive stone fist.

Top-Right sky: an enormous ancient elemental Dragon descending through thunderclouds, coils spanning across the sky, jaws wide releasing a torrent of sky-blue ether lightning (#8fdcff), glowing dragon scales and majestic horns.

Far-Right / High heavens: a radiant and terrifying divine manifestation of the God, a celestial towering figure of pure cosmic void and blinding violet-gold starlight (#a57ae6), surrounded by floating geometric glyphs and a colossal glowing five-pointed halo shining through split clouds.
The three titans clash toward the center from three angles (Earth & Fire vs Sky & Ether vs Cosmos & Divinity).
Foreground: dark shattered stone arena with ancient cracked runes, still dark reflective water or obsidian stone floor.

The centre 60% of the image where playing cards are placed must remain dark, shadowed and low-contrast so card text is readable. Keep explosive clashes and bright highlights in the upper sky and far corners.
Style: dark fantasy game art, painterly digital painting with rich texture, dramatic cinematic lighting; theme 'night sky and golden runes'.
Palette: night #07080d / #0d1019, gold #d9b46a / #f6e2a8, ether sky-blue #8fdcff, brass orange #d4893a, arcane violet #a57ae6.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no UI frame.
